description:
We are looking for an experienced IT Manager to lead our IT Department, overseeing processes such as: IT Infrastructure, Business Application & Data and Software Development. This role plays a key part in ensuring the reliability, security and continuous development of our IT operations, while aligning local business needs with the company's global IT strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • IT Operations & Infrastructure: Oversee the availability, performance, security and continuous development of the plant's IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, databases, applications and IT equipment.
  • Business Application & Data: Coordinate SAP and non-SAP activities, ensuring effective system administration, user support, process optimization and alignment with global IT standards.
  • People Management: Lead, develop and motivate the IT Department through clear objectives, delegation, coaching and performance management.
  • IT Strategy & Governance: Translate global IT strategies into local objectives and initiatives, ensuring compliance with corporate policies, IT security standards and applicable regulations.
  • Project Management: Coordinate IT and ERP implementation, development and improvement projects, ensuring proper planning, execution, testing, training and delivery.
  • Business Partnership: Collaborate with Process Owners and key stakeholders across Production, Logistics, Quality, Procurement, Sales and Finance to identify business needs and deliver effective IT solutions.
  • Budget & Cost Management: Prepare and manage the local IT budget in alignment with global IT guidelines, ensuring cost efficiency and effective resource allocation.
  • International Collaboration: Act as the main link between local and global IT teams, supporting international initiatives, standardization and the implementation of global solutions.

Professional Requirements

  • University degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar IT management or leadership position.
  • Good knowledge of English or German.
  • Good knowledge of MS Office and Outlook.
  • Understanding of core business processes across Production, Logistics, Quality, Procurement, Sales and Finance.
  • Knowledge of master data governance, reporting and data management.
  • Familiarity with IT Service Management (ITIL) and Project Management methodologies (PMI).
  • Understanding of IT infrastructure, network administration and information security principles.

Key Competencies

  • Strong leadership and people management skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong planning, organizational and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively in an international environment.
  • Customer-oriented mindset and a proactive approach to identifying solutions.
  • Adaptability, flexibility and resilience in a dynamic environment.
  • Ability to motivate, develop and engage team members.
  • Strong presentation and decision-making skills.
  • Cost awareness and business-oriented thinking.
